preconditions.description: The length of S must be between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in S must be lowercase latin characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (isinstance(return_value, int) and 1 <= return_value <= len(S))
postconditions.description: The return value must be -1 or an integer between 1 and the length of S.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or len(set(S[i:i+return_value])) == K for i in range(len(S) - return_value + 1)
postconditions.description: If the return value is not -1, there must be a substring of length return_value with exactly K distinct characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or not any(len(set(S[i:i+l])) == K and l > return_value for l in range(return_value + 1, len(S) + 1) for i in range(len(S) - l + 1))
postconditions.description: If the return value is not -1, there must not be any longer substring with exactly K distinct characters.
